## Summary
Adds `working-documents/AGENT-BEHAVIOR-TRACE-MODEL-CONTRACT.md` (v0.1-draft): the identity and relationship contract for the trace model — identities (conversation, runtime session, turn, model call, proposed action, approval decision, tool execution, external effect), the six relationships between them, candidate turn-boundary rules, interpretation rules for the four priority questions (missing observation is unknown, not zero; duplicates deduplicate by correlation key; reordered arrival must not change the answer), an OTel GenAI crosswalk, an AAIF terminology crosswalk, and the unresolved choices recorded explicitly.

## Related Issue
Updates #41 (does not close it — the draft is expected to be revised against the #40 baselines before any version is proposed as a recommendation).

## Review Notes
Please focus on: (1) whether the identity split (conversation vs. runtime session vs. turn) matches the August direction; (2) the candidate turn-boundary rules in section 5; (3) the interpretation rules in section 6; (4) whether the unresolved-choices list is complete. Per working methods this is specification content — suggesting the 2-week review window.

## Follow-ups
Revise against #40 baselines once captured; turn the fixture example into #42 fixtures; feed the terminology crosswalk into #10.
